newsitem.title: UK: T&N seen completing asbestos deal soon-paper.
newsitem.headline: T&N seen completing asbestos deal soon-paper.

text.p: UK motor components firm T&N Plc is about to complete an insurance deal limiting its liability to compensation claims for asbestos-related disease, the Sunday Times said.
"The agreement, which could be concluded within the next fortnight, should revitalise T&N's stagnant share price, but could also expose it to a hostile takeover bid," the newspaper said.

The paper quoted city experts as saying that under the terms of the agreement, being arranged by T&N's insurance broker Sedgwick, the company will retain exposure to a liability with a net present value of 300 to 400 million stg.
T&N would then pay an estimated 100 million stg premium to cover any liability above that limit, it said.
It said analysts believe the firm's actual liability is unlikely to exceed 400 million stg, but bearish market sentiment has built in a huge "asbestosis" discount into its share price.
The paper said the group's market value may almost double if T&N limits the asbestos costs to a maximum 500 million stg.
T&N shares closed on Friday at 133-1/2 pence a share on the London Stock Exchange after a 1996 peak of 187 pence.
